summary: F1 revision 11 at the current canonical hash is structurally strong: the canonical structural gate passes exit 0, the class-separation module returns 0 findings (the AF-WCC-VAC-GEN-SET soft flag is resolved at this hash by registering SET as a variant, not a class), the regression is 17/17 leaks + 10/10 controls with FP 0 / FN 0, all required class-bound slots are present, the quantifier order matches the frozen WCC reading, the conclusion is weak_cosmic_censorship with all five SCC/all-data strengthenings explicitly forbidden, and the map's measured hash agrees with disk. The verdict is revise on two machine-detected defects that make a full-schema accept at this hash unsafe: (1) the class quantifier domain D0 is still the two-disjunct regularity family 'Sobolev variant ... OR the smooth-with-decay default', mirrored in regularity.data_regularity and spanning two different ambient topologies (weighted Sobolev product at line 150 vs Frechet at line 151), with no transfer lemma, no registered data-class variant, and falsifier semantics that split across the disjuncts; this is the exact pattern already adjudicated as not acceptable for class identity (map reviews[43] HF-06 on F2a; reviews[70] Q2 names F1 as still unfixed) and it is G-FORM's unmet 'single frozen data class (s,delta,norm)' criterion. (2) class_contract_pointer names artifacts/formulation/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#class_contracts.AF-WCC-VAC-GEN while f0_binding declares research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml at sha256 276009f4; the pointer path is not the declared artifact and the key does not exist there (canonical F0 exposes 'classes', not 'class_contracts'), so the class-to-F0 binding is only verifiable against an unpinned authoring mirror. Both are bounded repairs, not a rejection: freeze one regularity setting and register the other as a variant, and repoint the contract key at the canonical path. This verdict adds no accept to G-FORM; independently of this review, F1 had no current-hash accept at the controller scan.

hard_failures.finding: Family-of-statements quantifier domain. quantifiers.domains.D0.definition (line 65) is 'admissible regularity pairs: Sobolev variant s > 5/2 and delta in (1/2,1), or the smooth-with-decay default', and conclusion.statement_formal (line 251) quantifies 'forall (s,delta) in D0'. The disjunction is mirrored in regularity.data_regularity (line 136: 'smooth-with-decay default, or H^s_delta with s > 5/2 and delta in (1/2,1)'), and the two disjuncts carry different ambient topologies: genericity.ambient_space (line 150) is the weighted Sobolev product H^s_delta x H^{s-1}_{delta+1} with the subspace topology, while genericity.topology_or_measure (line 151) adds 'Frechet topology for the smooth-with-decay class'. The artifact itself forbids transfer (regularity.must_not_conflate, lines 142-147: 'smooth-data statements may not be transferred to the Sobolev variant without an approximation/stability argument'), yet one class_id and one statement_formal cover both settings. No Sobolev/data-class variant is registered: VARIANT_REGISTRY.json variant_ids are [SET, CH, DISTRIBUTIONAL, H2LOC, TWOSIDED, L2CONN, LIP] (no Sobolev entry), and canonical F0 lists only [SET, CH] for this class. The falsifier semantics split with the domain: a single-regularity counterexample refutes the whole class, leaving the other disjunct untouched, which is not the same statement as a class-level generic failure.
